sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Brucebase with BruceBaseParser installed too: on a page where BruceBaseParser runs, the action button now reads 🎛 BruceBaseParser is on this page, with a hover text saying why, instead of making a table from the page BruceBaseParser has already changed (a year page's table came out empty, a show page lost its setlist and cast tables and counted BruceBaseParser's own tags and title marks as the wiki's). Link previews and every other page work as before; switch BruceBaseParser off for brucebase.wikidot.com to get the buttons back.
